instruction: A candid documentary medium-full shot captures an indoor studio with a red carpeted floor, white walls, and dark red partitions in the background. On the left, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands upright, facing slightly right. On the right, the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing left, leaning forward to touch the woman's (R2) right arm with his right hand. The scene is illuminated by bright overhead indoor lighting that casts soft shadows on the red carpet.
